prompt:
You are one of two AI models competing to triage a software engineer's inbox like he does. Last round he sorted the items himself in a game.
Bins:
- reply: he must write back himself
- archive: FYI / done / automatic, no action
- later: worth reading or doing, not now
- info: cannot act until a detail is supplied or clarified
- spam: marketing, noise or suspicious
Your weighted agreement with him: 26% over 30 items.
Items where you were wrong (subject -> your bin -> HIS bin):
- "Your application was viewed" -> reply -> archive
- "Invoice 3391 – payment overdue" -> info -> reply
- "Last chance to register: AI in logistics" -> info -> archive
- "[games] New issue: runner lags on old Android" -> later -> reply
- "[site] dependabot: bump undici to 6.21" -> later -> archive
- "Meet your new AI co-pilot for email" -> archive -> spam
- "Membership invoice – missing VAT number" -> spam -> reply
- "Guest slot – topic?" -> info -> reply
- "Role in Oslo or Copenhagen?" -> info -> archive
- "Interview confirmed: Thu 13:00" -> later -> reply
His sorts by sender type: collaborator: reply 6, info 1; github: reply 2, archive 1; invoice: reply 3, archive 2, info 1; job-board: archive 2, reply 1; marketing: archive 4, spam 2; newsletter: archive 2; recruiter: reply 5, archive 1; service: archive 3, reply 1
Your summary badges won 1/3 of the A/B style questions he answered.
Tasks:
1. Write a revised sorting rubric: 3 to 5 short rules that would match HIS sorting better.
2. Write 10 NEW fictional inbox items of the kinds he gets: recruiter replies, job-board digests, code-host (CI/PR/issue) notifications, service notices, marketing, collaborator questions, invoices, newsletters. Make some of them hard to sort.
Rules for items: sender is a role plus a made-up company, like "Recruiter · Pinewood Talent" or "Code host notifications"; NO personal names, NO email addresses, NO URLs, NO phone numbers, no placeholders like [name]. subject max 60 characters, snippet is one full sentence of 40 to 110 characters (the first line of the mail body). senderType one of: recruiter, job-board, github, service, marketing, collaborator, invoice, newsletter. Give your bin for each.
Example item (do not copy it): {"senderType":"recruiter","sender":"Recruiter · Pinewood Talent","subject":"Re: Backend role, quick follow-up","snippet":"Thanks for applying. Are you open to a 20 minute call on Thursday or Friday?","badge":"question","bin":"reply"}
Return JSON only, exactly 10 parcels: {"rubric":["rule 1","rule 2","rule 3"],"parcels":[ ... ]}
raw:
{
  "rubric": ["Rule 1: Prioritize actions that require immediate attention or follow-up.", "Rule 2: Classify items based on their urgency and importance.", "Rule 3: Use the sender's role and company to determine the appropriate bin."],

    {"senderType":"recruiter","sender":"Recruiter · Pinewood Talent","subject":"Re: Backend role, quick follow-up","snippet":"Thanks for applying. Are you open to a 20 minute call on Thursday or Friday?","badge":"question","bin":"reply"},
    {"senderType":"job-board","sender":"Job Board · TechJobs","subject":"New Job Posting: Senior Software Engineer","snippet":"We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with experience in React and Node.js.","badge":"info","bin":"info"},
    {"senderType":"github","sender":"GitHub · MyProject","subject":"CI/CD Issue: Build Failed","snippet":"The build failed with error 404. Please check the logs for more details.","badge":"info","bin":"info"},
    {"senderType":"marketing","sender":"Marketing · TechWorld","subject":"New Product Launch: AI Assistant","snippet":"Join our community to get the latest updates on the AI Assistant.","badge":"spam","bin":"archive"},
    {"senderType":"collaborator","sender":"Collaborator · MyProject","subject":"Meeting Request: AI Workshop","snippet":"Please join the AI Workshop on Monday at 10 AM.","badge":"reply","bin":"later"},
    {"senderType":"invoice","sender":"Invoice · TechCorp","subject":"Membership Invoice","snippet":"Please pay the membership invoice by the end of the week.","badge":"info","bin":"info"},
    {"senderType":"newsletter","sender":"Newsletter · TechNews","subject":"Tech News Update","snippet":"Check out the latest tech news in the newsletter.","badge":"info","bin":"info"},
